inputParameters.name: company_identifier
inputParameters.description: Company LinkedIn URL, Company Domain, Sales Navigator URL, or Sales Navigator Company ID. Use Company LinkedIn URL for highest accuracy. E.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/clay-run' or clay.com

inputParameters.name: job_title_keywords
inputParameters.description: Search for one or more comma-separated keywords in the person's job title. E.g 'Founder, Vice President'

inputParameters.name: job_title_exclude_keywords
inputParameters.description: Search for one or more comma-separated keywords that shouldn't be in the person's job title. E.g 'Vice, Junior'

inputParameters.name: locations
inputParameters.description: Search for one or more comma-separated locations. A location can be a city or a country. E.g. ‘Berlin’, 'United States'

inputParameters.name: locations_exclude
inputParameters.description: Exclude one or more comma-separated locations. A location can be a city or a country. E.g. ‘Berlin’, 'United States'

inputParameters.name: job_description_keywords
inputParameters.description: Search for one or more comma-separated keywords in the job description. E.g 'success, management'

inputParameters.name: has_recruiter
inputParameters.description: Only return jobs for which a recruiter is listed

inputParameters.name: max_num_days_since_posted
inputParameters.description: Return jobs posted within the specified number of days

inputParameters.name: min_num_days_since_posted
inputParameters.description: Return jobs posted before the specified number of days

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: Limit number of results returned. Defaults to 10. Maximum 10

inputParameters.name: identifiers_only
inputParameters.description: Only return minimal data (job title and job URL). Allows up to 500 results instead of 10.
